method: Each probe converted with `python3 abc2xml/abc2xml.py -o xml <probe>.abc`; XML inspected with xml.etree (inspect_probes.py), element counts attribute-order-independent.

code_map.ornMap: abc2xml.py:915-920 — decoration token -> MusicXML ornament element
code_map.uSyms: abc2xml.py:942-943 — single-char shorthands: ~=roll T=trill M=lowermordent P=uppermordent
code_map.doNotations: abc2xml.py:1350-1498 — ornMap branch at 1435-1441 (adds type=start when token contains '(' and lacks trailing ')'); phantom other-articulation fallback at 1455-1464
code_map.never_cleared_mechanism: doNotations else-branch (1456) calls staffDecos, whose final else (1810) re-appends the unknown token to s.nextdecos, so the next note re-processes it forever — shared root cause of D31 and the D95 propagation

findings.syntax: !trill! or shorthand T (uSyms T->trill, ornMap trill->trill-mark)
findings.evidence: p01: 2 notes decorated (one !trill!, one T) -> 2 ornaments/trill-mark, 0 other-articulation.

findings.syntax: documented in FEATURES.md as !trill(! / !trill)! -> <wavy-line>; direct tokens !wavy-line(! / !wavy-line)! also reachable via ornMap
findings.evidence: p02: wavy-line count = 0; start note emits <trill-mark type="start"> (type attr is not valid on trill-mark) and !trill)! emits nothing (0 elements) — the span never renders and never closes. p03: !wavy-line(! -> 1 wavy-line[type=start] (valid) but !wavy-line)! -> other-articulation="wavy-line)" (1 count, phantom, would propagate to any later notes); no stop is ever emitted.
findings.detail: d_clean = d.split('(')[0] strips '(' but not ')', so ')'-suffixed ornament tokens miss ornMap and fall to the phantom fallback; 'trill)' is only rescued by the skip-list at abc2xml.py:1459 (silently dropped, still re-appended to nextdecos forever).
findings.fix_hint: In the ornMap branch also match tokens ending in ')'; map trill(/trill) to wavy-line start/stop (that is what FEATURES.md promises) and wavy-line)/wavy-line( likewise; never emit type on trill-mark.

findings.evidence: p06: 1 ornaments/turn on the decorated note.
p07: 1 ornaments/delayed-turn + 1 ornaments/delayed-inverted-turn, one per decorated note.
p09: 6 ornaments/tremolo[type=single] with texts 1,2,3,1,2,3 on the 6 decorated notes; notated durations unchanged (quarter stays quarter).

findings.syntax: none reaches <tremolo>; natural guesses !////! and !trem4! are accepted by the parser but unmapped
findings.evidence: p10: 0 tremolo elements; other-articulation="////" on all 4 notes (the never-cleared phantom). p11: 0 tremolo; other-articulation="trem4" on all 4 notes. MusicXML allows tremolo marks 0-8.
findings.proposed_syntax: extend abc2xml.py:1802-1805 with '////' and 'trem4'..'trem8' -> s.trem = -n, consistent with existing forms; MuseScore supports up to 4 single-note tremolo beams.

findings.syntax: !/-! !//-! !///-! !////-! before the first note of the pair; write both notes at true sounding duration
findings.evidence: p12: 8 tremolo elements = 4 start/stop pairs with texts 1,2,3,4; each note notated type=half with time-modification 2:1 and duration 240 (sounding quarter), measure math consistent; 0 tuplet elements leak.
p13: 1 ornaments/schleifer on the decorated note.
p14: 1 ornaments/haydn on the decorated note.

findings.syntax: ~ shorthand before a note (uSyms '~' -> 'roll'; 'roll' absent from ornMap and artMap)
findings.evidence: p15: a single ~ on note 1 of 7 -> 7/7 notes carry articulations/other-articulation="roll"; 0 <ornaments> elements in the whole file (no turn, no inverted-mordent, no trill-mark). D95 reproduced exactly, including the D31-style never-cleared propagation: doNotations else-branch (1462-1464) emits the phantom AND staffDecos (1810) re-appends 'roll' to s.nextdecos each note.
findings.fix_hint: Map 'roll' to a real ornament (MusicXML has no <roll>: nearest are <turn/> or <inverted-mordent/>, or <other-ornament>roll</other-ornament> inside <ornaments>) and stop the nextdecos re-append loop for tokens already handled.

adjacent_untested: ornMap also carries shake, vertical-turn, inverted-vertical-turn (claimed in FEATURES.md); same code path as the working ornaments, not probed in this census.
